subject: planner: Fix expression rewriting and method signature mismatch in plan cache (#58506)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff: `expression.RemoveMutableConst` no longer returns early on the first `*ScalarFunction`, so it correctly traverses and freezes mutable constants across all provided sibling expressions (fixes incomplete ParamMarker/DeferredExpr removal). Checked the two call sites (`pkg/expression/builtin_compare.go`, `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go`) for plan-cache safety assumptions; no Blocker/High correctness or SQL semantics issues found, and the change remains unchanged in later `upstream/master`.
